canonical_statement: For a number field K: (i) for every finite abelian extension L/K, global reciprocity induces an isomorphism from the idele class group C_K modulo the norm subgroup N_{L/K}(C_L) to Gal(L/K); and (ii) finite-index open subgroups of C_K are precisely such norm subgroups, giving the inclusion-reversing existence/classification correspondence with finite abelian extensions of K in a fixed algebraic closure.
domain_and_universes: K is a finite extension of Q; L is a finite abelian extension of K inside a fixed algebraic closure; the exact Lean universes and topology instances are not yet selected
ordered_binders_candidate: Kbar : Type (chosen algebraic closure of K)
finite and Galois/abelian hypotheses on L/K
hypotheses: for reciprocity, L/K is finite and abelian
for existence, U is an open finite-index subgroup of the idele class group C_K
conclusion: The Artin reciprocity quotient isomorphism and the norm-subgroup/finite-abelian-extension existence correspondence both hold, including their inclusion reversal.
degenerate_and_boundary_cases: L = K should yield the trivial Galois group and full norm subgroup
U = C_K should correspond to the trivial extension
K = Q is a specialization, not the root theorem
archimedean places and ramified finite places remain in scope
